1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __within white matter tissue__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered to treat a neurological condition__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device creates the path by radial expansion rather than by blunt dissection__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining radial expansion throughout the procedure__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel patent__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path __by controlled radial expansion__; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path __in a controlled manner__; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the reinforced channel__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining separation of the tissue layers__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the working channel__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during the radial expansion phase__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __by sequential radial expansion__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path __in a controlled manner__; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue __and create a stable channel structure__; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while maintaining stent position__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __via the stent-reinforced channel__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __while preserving the stent in place__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the stent-reinforced channel__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __with the stent providing structural support__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
